• Made with DS Poly Mono Digital Print mesh - 100% Recycled Polyester
  • Frame made of DAC Aluminum and engineering plastic
  • Translucent tie-dyed design
  • Ultra lightweight and packable
  • Packed size: 37.2 x 11.5 x 11.5cm / Weight: 859g

Two brands that have spent decades making gear for people who would rather be outside than sitting still have come together to (a little ironically) make a chair. A chair that's just as ready to be on the go as you are. The Gramicci x Helinox Chair One takes the already iconic Chair One and gives it a translucent tie-dyed mesh seat. It weighs next to nothing and packs down small enough that you really have no excuse not to bring it. Find a good view, set it up in about thirty seconds, and enjoy... and when you're ready, pack it up and go.

Style Number: GAC6-S3100

body_html:

  • Dry-touch fabric for enhanced comfort

  • Classic crew neck and short sleeves
  • Male model is 6’ wearing size Medium

The Pomegranate Tee features a pomegranate graphic front and center, which is either a bold statement about appreciating fruit or just Gramicci continuing their tradition of putting unexpected things on shirts. The pomegranate itself sits above Gramicci branding looking vibrant and slightly defiant, as if daring you to question why a climbing brand is celebrating Mediterranean fruit... though honestly, climbers need to eat too, so it tracks. For people who want graphics that are not just logos or mountain scenes, who appreciate that sometimes the best designs are just visually interesting without requiring deep meaning, and who understand that a pomegranate on your chest is no stranger than half the other things people wear on t-shirts.

body_html:

The Greenicci Tee is Gramicci making a pun on their own name while advocating for environmental preservation, efficient branding meets earnest messaging. The leaf-adorned logo and "Preserve It" tagline deliver straightforward environmental advocacy without being preachy, which is the right tone for a brand whose customers already spend most of their time outside and understand why protecting nature matters. Small chest logo on front, larger graphic on back provides typical t-shirt hierarchy without overthinking placement. For people who want their clothing choices to reflect environmental values without wearing statement pieces that scream about it, sometimes the message can be simple, direct, and printed on comfortable cotton that you will actually wear regularly.

title: Natural Dyed Gadget Pant
body_html:
• Made with an eco-friendly 100% cotton material
  • Elastic waistband with integrated nylon belt and diamond-shaped crotch gusset
  • Low-rise pants with tapered fit
  • Large wrap-around pockets
  • Colored with natural dye created from plants and minerals such as leaves, roots, bark, or flowers
  • Model is 6’ wearing size Medium

A long-lost Gramicci classic, the Gadget Pants were first designed back in the early 90s as the ultimate utility pants. Sitting somewhere between climbing pants and painter pants, they’re seriously useful; with contrasting canvas pockets that extend from the front around to the back for unparalleled haulage, while that extra webbing strip above the right pocket is prime for keeping keys, carabiners, or water bottles right where you need ‘em. These newly developed Gadget Pants have the same relaxed, straight-legged silhouette as they have had since conception in the 90s. But that new, unique colorway? Made from all-natural pigment, derived from plants and minerals. The same Gadget Pants you've known and loved, but with an patina that will age like fine wine.

Style Number: G6SM-P003-D

title: Gramicci & retaW Carabiner Car Tag
body_html:
• Created in collaboration with retaW
  • Carabiner-shaped car freshener - 100% Paper
  • Includes paracord for easy hanging
  • Scent: fresh mountain air with green leaves and subtle floral notes, finished with cedarwood and musk

Some people hang a pine tree from their rearview mirror. Gramicci people hang a carabiner. Created in collaboration with fragrance specialists retaW, this car tag brings the outside in,  or at least makes your commute smell like it. The carabiner shape is a nod to Gramicci's climbing roots, while the scent does the heavy lifting: fresh mountain air, green leaves, a hint of floral, and a base of cedarwood and musk that keeps things grounded. Clip it, hang it, and let every drive feel a little more like an adventure.

Also, the webbing belt with the brand logo on the right side is useful outdoors and in the city, as it can hold keys and bottles. They are made of 100% organic cotton twill with high durability, tension, and stiffness that can even withstand strenuous movement and dyed to give character to their appearance.

title: W's Voyager Pant
body_html:
• Made with Organic Cotton Twill - 100% Cotton
  • Loose silhouette
  • Features four large side pockets
  • Durable material
  • Inseam 27 - 28"
  • Model - Height: 5'6" - Wearing size Small

Got an upcoming voyage? Take the Voyager Pants with you for built-in functionality and a comfortable journey. These pants have four large pockets extending from the front to the back to carry all your tools, equipment, and souvenirs. They stand out among other outdoor wear because of their loose silhouette and achieve durability, making them the perfect barrel pant. Thanks to their 100% organic cotton twill–a fabric with high durability, tension, and stiffness–these pants can withstand strenuous movement. This organic material is dyed to give character to the pants' appearance and feature easy day-to-day care, which makes them great for everyday use, all year round. Become a stylish, prepared voyager on every adventure, whether in the city or in the great outdoors, with the Voyager Pants.

title: Gadget Short
body_html:
• Large pockets front to back
  • Made with Organic Cotton Twill - Cotton 100% 
  • Zipped fly closure
  • Shorts feature a D-ring for holding keys or other items
  • Relaxed fit
  • Inseam 10-11"
  • Model - Height: 5'10" - Wearing size Small

These shorts are able to hold gadgets to suit modern lifestyles, while maintaining the functionality during climbing that serves as the brand's roots. Highlighted by large pockets extending from the front to the back, the silhouette combines a comfortable looseness with a smart appearance. Tough canvas is used for these pockets, while the contrast between the two types of materials through garment dyeing is another notable feature. Also, the D-ring with the brand logo on the right side is useful in the outdoors and in the city, as it can hold keys and bottles. They are made of 100% organic cotton twill with high durability, tension, and stiffness that can even withstand strenuous movement and dyed to give character to their appearance.

Style Number: G104-OGT

Gramicci NN-Shorts are outdoor lifestyle shorts designed to be a comfortable and durable urban lifestyle clothing item. These outdoor shorts are made from organic stretch twill and offered in a variety of colors. title: Loose Tapered Pant
body_html:
• Pants washed for a vintage look and soft hand feel 
  • Low rise and loose fit along hemline 
  • Flexible waistband for optimal flexibility 
  • Two front pockets and two side pockets 
  • Made with 100% Organic Cotton Twill 
  • Inseam 26"
  • Model - Height: 5'10" - Wearing size Small 

The aptly-titled Loose Tapered Pant–they’re loose, yet tapered.
These are the Gramicci pants of choice for anyone looking for a roomy, relaxed pair of outdoor pants. Designed in Japan, the Loose Tapered Pants have plenty of room around the waist and thighs, with a sharp taper from the knee to the hem. These pants are cropped at the ankle for a shorter shape—with the hems sitting well above footwear, no cuff needed. Another unique feature is the different pockets–instead of the usual slash pockets there are two big rectangular patch pockets, a detail inspired by 1960s military fatigue pants. Don’t sacrifice style or comfort for functionality; choose the Loose Tapered Pant from Gramicci.

Gramicci's innovative line of pants was created in the 1980s, delivering all the features climbers were looking for thanks to the company's climbing experience. These climbing pants are the ladies' version of the Gramicci Pants that crowns this brand name. Not too snug for a grunge look and compared to the men's version, it has a smarter silhouette. Therefore, these urban-style pants have no gusset crotch. Made with Gramicci's classic Organic Twill Cotton, they are robust enough to stand up to intense movement, while their colors bring a sense of style and vibe. This classic Organic Twill Cotton material is synonymous with Gramicci. Garment dye is added after the piece of clothing creating unique, visual textures and deep colors. Garment dyeing produces a rich variety of colors like no other in the world of textiles. Gramicci's Cotton Twill is highly durable and keeps its shape well. It requires only simple day-to-day care, making it the perfect material for everyday use.

title: Gramicci Pant
body_html:
• The Original 1982 Gramicci Pants
  • Made with 100% Organic Cotton Twill
  • Features gusseted crotch for freedom-of-movement
  • Easy-adjust waistband with integrated belt and buckle 
  • Zip fly with two side seam pockets and two back welt pockets
  • Relaxed fit and low rise
  • Inseam 32"
  • Model - Height: 5'10" - Wearing size Medium 

These are the original Gramicci Pants that started the "Freedom of Movement." The design was created in the 1980s from Gramicci's innovative line of pants. The Gramicci Pants delivered all the features rock climbers were looking for thanks to the company's wealth of climbing experience. Over time, these outdoor pants have evolved and have been updated to meet the needs of the modern climber with new features including a bit of extra room around the hips, a front zip fly opening, with left and right back pockets. Gramicci's climbing pants have become a staple over the years and continue to win new devotees today for a variety of applications. 

These outdoor life pants feature a crotch gusset that allows 180-degree splits and a webbing belt with easy-adjust waistband that can be adjusted with one hand. Made of 100% organic cotton twill with high durability, tension, and stiffness that can even withstand strenuous movement and dyed to give character to their appearance.

Style Number: G102-OGT
